name: nationality_to_country
description: Map a nationality adjective to its country (German -> Germany). Control: same format but copy the adjective.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('German','Germany'),('French','France'),('Italian','Italy'),('Spanish','Spain'),('Japanese','Japan'),('Chinese','China'),('Russian','Russia'),('Canadian','Canada'),('Brazilian','Brazil'),('Indian','India'),('Mexican','Mexico'),('Turkish','Turkey'),('Greek','Greece'),('Polish','Poland'),('Swedish','Sweden'),('Norwegian','Norway'),('Dutch','Netherlands'),('Egyptian','Egypt'),('Korean','Korea'),('Australian','Australia'),('Portuguese','Portugal'),('Irish','Ireland'),('Argentine','Argentina'),('Thai','Thailand'),('Vietnamese','Vietnam'),('Finnish','Finland'),('Danish','Denmark'),('Swiss','Switzerland'),('Austrian','Austria'),('Belgian','Belgium'),('Chilean','Chile'),('Peruvian','Peru'),('Kenyan','Kenya'),('Nigerian','Nigeria'),('Iranian','Iran'),('Hungarian','Hungary')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    sh=random.sample(P,3); q=random.choice([o for o in P if o not in sh])
    p=''.join(f"Nationality: {a}\nCountry: {b}\n\n" for a,b in sh)+f"Nationality: {q[0]}\nCountry:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+q[1]})
    p2=''.join(f"Nationality: {a}\nSame word: {a}\n\n" for a,b in sh)+f"Nationality: {q[0]}\nSame word:"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":" "+q[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
